Scope: Synthetic IEC water/noise/slice-thickness tables, manufacturer Daily inline single-system HU tables and bounded Monthly alignment tables. Explicit current HU values and printed bounds are kept separate from parenthesized references, scan parameters, other tables and clinical approval. Unknown, incomplete, conflicting, ambiguous and clipped evidence remains marked for review.
